acceptance.given: A Consumer success-path evaluation is executed against the repository-owned replay implementation with its required Consumer route set and route-invocation evidence available.

oracle.expected: The terminal success result is emitted only when every required Consumer route check is actually reachable and executed on that success path, with attributable invocation evidence for each route.
forbidden: A required Consumer route check is unreachable on a success path.
A successful result is accepted when a required Consumer route check was bypassed.
oracle.observable: The replay result and execution evidence enumerate every required Consumer route check, show an invocation for each on the success path, and reject any missing, unreachable, or bypassed route.

acceptance.then: The success-path evaluation must confirm complete reachability and execution of all required Consumer route checks before returning success.
acceptance.when: A Consumer success path is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the success-path route evaluation with one required Consumer route made unreachable or omitted; the evaluator must fail closed and must not produce a successful result.

affected_subjects: Required Consumer routes on Consumer success paths
slice_hint.behavior_change: The replay success-path evaluation verifies and records execution of every required Consumer route check; any unreachable, omitted, or bypassed check prevents success.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay result categories and Consumer route interfaces; only strengthen success-path closure so missing route execution fails closed.

slice_hint.state_transition: Consumer success-path evaluation transitions to success only after all required route checks reach and complete their real invocation; otherwise it transitions to an unsuccessful terminal result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Success is terminally valid iff every required Consumer route check has a reachable, executed invocation with attributable evidence; any missing or bypassed route yields failure.
